source: Google Earth web historical imagery: aerials of 8 Feb 2022 (anchor) and 2 Oct 2024, straight-down captures at 0.132 m a pixel. Each date's painted line traced along 1440 rays; 2024 lined up on 2022 by the line itself (shift [3.535, 2.05] m) and the median taken. Goals: 50 m arc then the goal square (north-east goal on both dates, 0.49 m apart; south-west goal 2022 only).

error_m.placement: Google Earth places the 2022 and 2024 aerials 4.1 m apart, so the frame is the 2022 aerial's (line, goals and fence all from it). Checked against main's model (a first draft by eye) in a match top-down render: model fence edge minus traced fence median -0.32 m, p5-p95 -1.6 to +2.3 m; painted line in the match vs trace rms 0.40 m.

frame: Google Earth's georeference of the 8 Feb 2022 aerial, in model metres (x east, z south) about tools/grounds/ge/grounds.json's North Hobart origin.
fence_how: where the grass stops (for 1.5 m) going outward from the line in the same 2022 aerial; points more than 1 m off a robust smooth fit are fence_seen false.
